title: Connectors: Plugging Claude into Your Tools

questions.prompt: What open standard are Claude's connectors built on?
questions.explanation: Connectors use MCP, an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external systems, which its docs compare to USB-C.

questions.prompt: Match each connector type to its characteristics.

pairs.right: Runs in the cloud and works on every surface
Runs locally in Claude Desktop and Claude Code
A remote MCP server URL you add yourself

questions.explanation: Remote connectors are the default and work everywhere; desktop extensions run locally; custom connectors point at any remote MCP server.

questions.prompt: Free users can add ____ custom connector.
questions.explanation: Custom remote MCP connectors are available on every plan, but Free users are limited to one.

questions.prompt: Which are good safety habits with connectors? Select all that apply.

options.text: Only connect services you trust and need
Review actions before Claude sends or changes anything
Disconnect services you no longer use
Enable every connector in every chat for convenience

questions.explanation: Connect only trusted, needed services, review write actions (prompt injection is possible), and disconnect unused ones. Enable connectors per chat as needed.

questions.prompt: Why can't a custom connector reach a server that only exists on your private home network?

options.text: Claude connects from Anthropic's cloud, so the server must be reachable over the public internet
Custom connectors only support Google services
Private servers are only allowed on the Free plan
Claude connects from your laptop's Wi-Fi card

questions.explanation: Claude connects to custom connectors from Anthropic's cloud infrastructure, not your machine. Private networks may need allowlisting; local tools can use desktop extensions.

questions.prompt: Order the steps to use a connector in a conversation.

items.text: In a chat, toggle it on from + > Connectors
Find the connector in the directory
Review any proposed actions before they run
Click Connect and sign in to the service

questions.explanation: Find it in the directory, connect and authenticate once, enable it per chat, and review actions as Claude works.
